title: The Crooked Oath Anew
author: Gideon Coldharbour
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, a thief who steals memories, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
